title: Ponder Datapack Resourcepack
body:
A resoucepack dependency for [Ponder Datapack](https://modrinth.com/project/maFYa7Eh).

## Features

* Add Create mod icons as a font (unauthorized use).

## Dependencies

### Resourcepacks
* [Wireframe Display](https://github.com/HalbFettKaese/WireframeDisplay) (Required) Add dyeable wire frames.

## Links
